notices.title: IDS & CareerXel – Emerging Technology Workshop Series 2026
notices.description: Comprehensive online emerging technology workshop series focusing on Artificial Intelligence (AI), Cybersecurity, Blockchain Technology, Product Management, and Industry & Career Guidance. Learn directly from industry experts, gain practical insights, develop future-ready skills, and earn a Blockchain-Verified Certificate.
notices.eligibility: Open to all enrolled students across all branches and academic years. Free registration.
notices.concerned_authorities: IDS & CareerXel Industry Partnership Desk / GNIOT Training & Placement Cell
required_documents: Registered Email for Online Portal Access

notices.title: SHE INNOVATES 2.0 - IDEATHON (She Ideates | She Presents | She Wins)
notices.description: Inter-College Idea Competition organized exclusively for female students by WISE Society of Greater Noida Institute of Technology. Teams of 1 to 2 members present original and innovative solutions with a max 8-slide PPT covering Problem, Solution, Technology & Outcome (5 min presentation + 2 min Q&A). Organized under the leadership of Prof. (Dr.) Dhiraj Gupta (Director), Prof. (Dr.) Seema Arora (President-WISE, HOD EE), and Dr. Monika Dixit (Vice President-WISE).
notices.eligibility: Exclusively for Female Students from Any College / Branch / Year. Teams of 1 to 2 members.
notices.reward_amount: Prizes for Winners + Official Certificates for All Participants
notices.concerned_authorities: Team WISE, GNIOT (Innovation Centre & Department of Electrical Engineering)
required_documents: College Student ID Card (Female Students Only)
Max 8 Slides PPT (Problem, Solution, Technology, Outcome)

notices.title: Blood Donation Camp 2026 - Social Club GNIOT & Rotary Club
notices.description: Life-saving blood donation camp organized by The Social Club of GNIOT in association with Rotary Club. Staff, faculty members, and students from B.Tech 132 and all campus departments are encouraged to register and step forward. Donors will be provided official attendance in lieu of their presence in the camp. 'Your Blood Can Be Someone's Lifeline — Be a Hero, Donate Today!'
notices.eligibility: Open to all staff, faculty members, and students (B.Tech 132 & all branches). Donors must be 18+ and medically eligible.
notices.reward_amount: Donor Honor Certificate, Refreshments & Official Attendance Waiver
notices.concerned_authorities: The Social Club of GNIOT & Rotary Club Liaison Desk (GIPS Seminar Wing)

notices.title: Industrial Visit at Microsoft India - Sovereign Capital Sector 16A Noida
notices.description: The Department of Computer Science & Engineering, in collaboration with GNIOT CSE Tech Club, is pleased to announce an exclusive industrial visit to Microsoft India. Experience the professional corporate environment of a global technology leader, gain direct industry exposure, and understand enterprise cloud & software architectures.
notices.eligibility: Exclusively for 2nd & 3rd Year CSE Students. Strictly limited to 50 participants (selection based on registration details).
notices.reward_amount: Corporate Industry Exposure & Official Visit Participation Certificate
notices.concerned_authorities: Department of Computer Science & Engineering & GNIOT CSE Tech Club
required_documents: CSE Student ID Card (2nd or 3rd Year)
notices.timing: 8th August 2026 (Saturday) | Visit: 10:00 AM – 12:00 PM | Reporting: 9:00 AM at Campus
notices.venue: Microsoft Sovereign Capital Sector 16A, Noida (College Bus Facility Provided)

notices.title: SIH 2026 – Internal Smart India Hackathon at GNIOT (Think. Build. Innovate. Compete.)
notices.description: Internal qualification hackathon for Smart India Hackathon (SIH 2026) organized by the Department of Computer Science & Engineering & GNIOT-CSE Tech Club. Participating teams showcase innovative technical prototypes, embedded engineering, and software architectures to secure official institutional nomination for the national Smart India Hackathon.
notices.eligibility: All participating B.Tech / CSE teams registered for Smart India Hackathon 2026. Teams of 6 members including at least one female teammate.
notices.reward_amount: Official GNIOT Nomination for National SIH 2026 + Institutional Grants
notices.concerned_authorities: Department of Computer Science & Engineering & GNIOT-CSE Tech Club

notices.title: GNIOT Merit Excellence Scholarship 2026-27
notices.description: State and institutional merit sponsorship grant for undergraduate engineering students with annual parental income below 2.5 LPA and CGPA above 7.5.
notices.eligibility: B.Tech students with CGPA >= 7.50, zero active backlogs, annual family income under ₹2,50,000.
notices.concerned_authorities: Contact Registrar Office, Dean, or relevant HOD Section (Desk 4, Student Welfare Section, Ground Floor Block A)
required_documents: Tehsildar Signed Income Certificate (Current Financial Year)
GNIOT Student ID Card & Bonafide Certificate
Nationalized Bank Passbook Front Page (Aadhaar Linked)

notices.title: Alumni Foundation Tech Innovator Grant
notices.description: Crowdsourced alumni foundation fellowship for students publishing open-source software, competitive robotics, or AI projects.
notices.eligibility: Open to all 2nd & 3rd year engineering students with a published GitHub project or national podium finish.
notices.concerned_authorities: Contact Registrar Office, Dean, or relevant HOD Section (Room 102, Innovation Incubation Hub, CR Aman / Prof. V. Patil)
required_documents: GitHub Repository URL & Architecture Readme PDF
Recommendation Letter from Department Faculty Mentor
